title: Good-Through Date Schedule for Kestrel Advantage Balloon Customer Payoff Quotes
content:
**Quote good-through schedule.** The good-through date of a customer payoff quote on a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract follows the position of the quote date against the maturity date:

| Quote date | Good-through date |
|---|---|
| After the maturity date | The quote date itself |
| On or before the maturity date, with the maturity date no more than 30 calendar days away | The maturity date |
| On or before the maturity date, with the maturity date more than 30 calendar days away | 10 calendar days after the quote date (the tier's quote validity days, 10 on every tier) |

The schedule never sets the good-through date later than 10 calendar days after the quote date. Calendar days from one date to another count the later date and not the earlier one.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical, maturity on the 31st of a month)

- Quote on the 1st of that month: maturity is 30 days away, good through the 31st.
- Quote on the last day of the previous month (31 days away): good through 10 days after the quote date.
- Quote on the 31st itself: good through the 31st.
- Quote on the 1st of the following month: after maturity, good through the 1st.
